properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sops-nix secrets at rest, committed in this repo — a harvest-now-decrypt-later target: the X25519 key wrap is Shor-vulnerable, so captured secrets files become decryptable once quantum hardware matures. Data layer AES-256-GCM is PQ-adequate; the key wrap is the gap. Changeable here: re-wrap with a PQ KEM once sops/age ships one (sops 3.13.3 today).

properties.name: pqs:context
